items.raw_excerpt: The world road cycling championships are returning to the Netherlands for the first time in more than 20 years after Groningen and Drenthe won the contest to stage the 2034 edition. The two northern provinces had originally bid for the championships in 2032, but the international cycling union UCI awarded that year’s event to Pune, the first time it will be held in India. “It’s brilliant that this is happening, it’s really a dream,” said Bauke Mollema, Groningen-born Tour de...
items.summary_en: The world road cycling championships will come to the Netherlands in 2034. The northern provinces of Groningen and Drenthe won the contest. The last Dutch time was more than 20 years ago. The 2032 race goes to Pune, India instead.
items.summary_ko: 2034년 세계 노면 자전거 선수권 대회가 네덜란드에서 열립니다. 북부 두 도주인 흐로닝겐과 드렌테가 유치권을 얻었습니다. 네덜란드 개최는 20년 만입니다. 2032년 대회는 대신 인도 푸네에서 열립니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The smaller cities in northern Spain not only beat out Madrid and Barcelona in quality of life rankings, but also major international capitals.
items.summary_en: Two small cities in Galicia, in northern Spain, came first in a new quality of life ranking. The same ranking placed Madrid and Barcelona near the bottom. People say the smaller cities are calmer, greener, and easier to live in.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 북부 갈리시아의 작은 도시 두 곳이 새로 나온 생활 만족도 순위에서 1위를 차지했다. 같은 순위에서 마드리드와 바르셀로나는 뒤를 다했다. 작은 도시들이 조용하고 녹지가 많아 살기 쉽다는 평가다.
items.title_en: Two Galician Cities Named Spain's Best for Quality of Life
